job: Start an app page from the shell as plain markup, when a server renders every page and no script should run.
purpose: The app shell with no shell.js: sidebar, top bar, command palette and phone menu as markup, with a filtered table in the page. The server sets the title, the current nav item, the hero and the bands. It has no states to switch with the address, by design: the server renders loading, empty or failing screens itself, from filled skeleton presets (skeleton() in fire-design/skeleton) and fd-empty.
useWhen: Pages are rendered by a server and the app must run with a strict content security policy.
A page should carry as little script as possible.

avoidWhen.when: The pages are a single-page app that can build the shell with a script.

states.name: default
states.how: none beyond the default: the server chooses what to render; no ?state= runs script here
